mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO billing_account (namespace, plan_code, status) VALUES (#{namespace}, #{planCode}, 'active')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM billing_account WHERE namespace = #{namespace} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM billing_account WHERE _id = #{accountId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM billing_plan WHERE plan_code = #{planCode} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO billing_period (account_id, period_start, period_end, quota_bytes, billed_bytes) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{periodStart}, #{periodEnd}, #{quotaBytes}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT m._id, m.account_id, m.tunnel_id, m.usage_bytes, m.reported_at FROM tunnel_metering m WHERE m.settled = 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM cluster c WHERE c.cluster_id = m.cluster_id AND c.region = #{region} ) ORDER BY m.created_at ASC, m._id ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE billing_account a INNER JOIN billing_period bp ON bp.account_id = a._id AND bp.period_start = #{periodStart} SET a.quota_blocked_until = GREATEST(a.quota_blocked_until, bp.period_end) WHERE a._id = #{accountId} AND bp.billed_bytes >= bp.quota_bytes AND a.quota_blocked_until < bp.period_end
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO billing_usage_1m (account_id, tunnel_id, window_start, usage_bytes) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{tunnelId}, #{windowStart}, #{usageBytes}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE usage_bytes = usage_bytes + VALUES(usage_bytes)
